issues.issue: Supported under the relaxed fund-name rule. The amounts tie exactly (p5 column = p17 Total), and in Nebraska a tax increment financing fund's 'Taxes' is the property tax increment, a single tax type. It is still a judgment call: TIF is not one of the rule's example fund names, and the report does not label the money property tax. The same applies to detail[76] (220,718, p17). The four receipts pieces (4,182,032 + 160,979 + 220,718 + 4,925,740) add to Taxes 9,489,469 exactly, and the remainder equals General 3,132,290 + Debt Service 331,006 + Street 1,462,444.

The fund-name pieces carry made-up labels. The page prints only 'Taxes', and the same goes for receipts[2] 'TIF Funds Taxes' (p17 prints 'Taxes'). The lodging classification (160,979, Hotel/Motel Tax Fund) is supported under the relaxed fund-name rule.
